snippet.title: asses.masses | Trailer
snippet.description:
https://bac.org.uk/whats-on/asses-masses/

asses.masses | 12 - 13 Apr 2025

Co-direction, text, programming, pixel art, 2D animation: Patrick Blenkarn (Canada)
Co-direction, text, sound design, video, shaders, 3D visual effects: Milton Lim (Canada)
Dramaturgy, text, touring producer: Laurel Green (Canada)

asses.masses invites the audience to play out the epic journey of a herd of donkeys trying to get their jobs back. It is a custom-made video game about labour, technophobia and sharing the load of revolution, designed to be played from beginning to end in a live theatre.
